name: pipeline_benzonitrile_anharmonic
purpose: TASKS 211: the anharmonic step's second real run - a substituted molecule (benzonitrile, 13 atoms, a linear group) through the pipeline with the step asked for, after benzene's first run of 17 Nov 2026 (458 s for the force field and its label at a 1042 MB peak; 26 of 30 bands stepped, a degenerate pair lost to the one-to-one mode matching). Steps 2-3 come from the corpus (--reuse-only). Read: bands stepped and lost with their reasons, the time and the peak.
command: env CORPUS_QC_PYTHON=C:/Users/thebr/.conda/envs/qc/python.exe PYTHONUTF8=1 python -m m08.pipeline --name benzonitrile --smiles N#Cc1ccccc1 --out ../../probes/results_m1/pipeline_benzonitrile_anharmonic_second_run --threads 4 --reuse-only --anharmonic-minutes 120

estimate.basis: benzene's force field and label took 458 s on 17 Nov 2026 (pipeline_benzene_anharmonic); 13 atoms need 67 Hessians against 61

memory.basis: a bound for the WSL side: probes/run_in_scope.sh runs the force field and its label in a systemd scope with MemoryMax 1536 MB and no swap; beside it the Windows python of the pipeline with the network's three checkpoints and kernel ridge on 1,600 rows: under 0.8 GB. --reuse-only: neither psi4 nor pyscf runs
